title: Sunset shrub
steps: Crush the blackberries and raspberries. Mix them with the raw cane sugar. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 2 days so the berries macerate.
Strain the juice and mix it with the red wine vinegar. Refrigerate for at least 1 week before using.
Pour the sparkling water, add the shrub, and top with the freshly squeezed orange juice.
